review_description: I recently had a solar system installed by Smart House Solar, and I couldn't be happier. There prices were the best in the market for top quality products they supplied. The installation went smoothly with a team of very skilled people that new their job. I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking to install a solar system. Thank you all at Smart House solar for all your help in getting my solar system completed. And a special thanks to Frank Williams for all the work he did from start to finish of the project.

I had a wonderful experience with Smarthouse solar from quote to installation, Frank Williams and  his team were very  friendly and  understanding with spot on communication. recommended  for any solar need.
Very good customer service, taken care of everything and the installation happened as committed. Very transparent and seamless operations, easy to deal, highly recommend
Such a great experience very fast and reliable and happy to answer all my questions.

I recently had a solar system installed by Smart House Solar, and I couldn't be happier. Not only were their prices unbeatable, but their team also went above and beyond to ensure a timely and hassle-free installation. The entire process, from the initial consultation to the final inspection, was well-organized and efficient.
Great service, high quality installation, reasonably priced. Great to be doing our part for the planet. Thank you Smart House Solar.

Fantastic service and great communication.   We tried for almost a year to have solar installed and Smart House Solar had our system installed within 6 weeks of getting our quote.  They kept us informed and even followed up with us after the installation was completed.   Highly recommend them.
I am very happy with my solar panel purchase. The support has been excellent, especially from Ken.
Wonderful experience!!!! Frank is amazing So much knowledge and flexibility. After care fantastic!!! I did allot of homework and was worried but they took all that away so happy!!! Seamless!!!
Top work done by the lads in a timely manner with great safety and environmental awareness. Thumps up for the flow less organising shown by  the whole team.Highly Recommended.

I went thru Smart House Solar to install my quality Solar System due to affordability and extremely genuine quality service. I'd paid deposit and researchemy panels etc and looked forward to the installation However we found ie installer and I, my roof couldn't support roof mounted panels. It is a eco bespoke roof so I've had to cancel the panels much to my own fault. Smart House Solar refunded my deposit promptly. Please let me tell you quality and affordable panels are what brought to Smart House Solar.. I implore you to do the same.

I have paid a deposit for a system totalling over $22,000 for this install. This would have been the forth solar system I have organised for one of my properties and have NEVER dealt with such an incompetent orgisnation such as smart house solar. I received a quote from smart house solar and paid a deposit and here we are over three months later and I am still yet to get a installation date-- They flat out lied, gave me one but that was clearly never intended for them to meet as one day before the supposed installation day they were still trying to organise an installer.This companies whole this is to lie and tell you one more day and never call or actually deliver hoping you leave it -- I am not convinced they are not even a scam origination.Another week on and still no installation date or follow up from these clowns. There has been no follow up or feedback from the sales / installation team I have to constantly call them and they always promise one more day and they will call back but never do - I would avoid this company and look else where and this is before they have my money - cant imagine how bad it would be if you needed after sales service with them

I was considering renewing my 20+ year old solar system this year, so I tried several quotes and finally chose Smart House Solar for their competitive price and superb customer reputation and customer support. The whole quoting and installation process was super smooth and I couldn't be happier now with the new 10.5kw solar system. Highly recommended.

No installation. Sadly they keep cancelling my install. 3 times now. Had enough I also had an installer calling me asking for payment before installation I said no. Very disappointed as had previously used them with no problem. I do not recommend.

3 years ago I purchased a rooftop solar system from smart house solar and it went well, so it was a no brainer to use them again when I decided to upsize my solar system to better meet my needs. After paying my deposit they booked in the installation for a few weeks later, however the installation never happened and all I got in return were apologies for the inconvenience and a rescheduled installation date. This happened over and over again for the next 3 months. Finally they agreed to refund my money after I complained that they had not met the consumer guarantee to provide the service within a reasonable amount of time. Their empty promises continued when they told me it would take 14 days to process the refund. It ended up taking nearly 2 months to get my money back after I engaged a lawyer to write a letter of demand and made a complaint with the office of fair trading. All in all it took 5 months from when I paid my deposit to when I finally got my money back. I find their conduct to be reprehensible and extremely dishonest. Find a more trustworthy company... they may be cheap but their service is terrible.
Sales just want your money.Installation promised twice, but no show.Their installer have never heard from Smart House Solar.They got the money, but I got no solar.I have reported them to ACCC.

Purchased 8/11/2022.  Installation cancelled without consent on 8/12/2022.  Rescheduled Several times after this date the morning of the new agreed installation time.  Installation installed at sight unseen on21/01/2023.  Less panels placed on roof and quote was for aerial shot of roof which had angles wrong.  Email from installation team was not forwarded onto energy company until the 8/02/2023.  Solar finally connected to grid 31/02/2023.  Dongle for app connection was faulty.  Still not working. Communication was terrible.  Phone calls not answered or call back when they said they would.  Promised us they would reimburse us the power bills for our two townhomes but when sent through, they were ignored.  We have been left quite traumatized after this long drawn out ordeal.  We purchased two sets of solar panels for our two townhomes, only to be left financially viable for their unprofessional delay in a product that should have been a pleasure to purchase and deal with.  We would strongly recommend looking elsewhere.

Solar System Keeps Shutting Down Every Fifteen Minutes And They Will Not Help. Smart House Solar nor my Installer will not fix the problem of the Inverter Shutting Down and they told me that I would have to get Origin to fix the problem with the lines. Lucky there are people out there that know there job and I was able to get someone that knows what he is doing to fix the problem at my cost and it has not shut down since, Do Not Buy From Smart House Solar.
The sales process was quick and easy and explained in great depth.

This installer was brilliant offering many options and opinions to achieve the best solution for my system with by far the best price amongst 8 installers I contact.I absolutely recommend to consider and contact Smart House Solar.

The salesman was a little pushy. Also he got some technical facts wrong, but so did ALL the companies who gave me quotes.The quote was the cheapest by far. I spent a long time reviewing the hardware and could not find any particular reason why I should pay more for another similar system.The installation was punctual and efficient, but they did not make a great effort to install the panels in my preferred location. I only realised this later.I really won't know the full value of the system until I have seen a full year's cycle of solar power. So far the daily kWh values, according to the installed app, are quite impressive.I don't know if the feed-in system is working, since my retailer has not installed the smart meter yet. They know I have solar panels but don't seem to have done anything about it yet. Meanwhile my electricity meter is zooming backwards every day. My solar installer assured me I need take no further step at this stage.
Fuss free, prompt, straight forward, quick, clean, clear, accommodating, relieved.
